platform.name: Telangana Arms License Management System (ALMS)
platform.tagline: Official Arms Licensing, Regulation & Enforcement Portal — Government of Telangana
platform.description: The official digital governance platform of the Government of Telangana for regulating arms and ammunition licensing, renewals, jurisdiction transfers, and enforcement monitoring under the statutory provisions of The Arms Act, 1959, The Arms Rules, 2016, and the Telangana Police regulatory framework.
platform.stateJurisdiction: State of Telangana (All Police Commissionerates & District Magistracies)
platform.actReference: The Arms Act, 1959, The Arms Rules, 2016 & Hyderabad City Police Act

announcements: GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA DIRECTIVE: Mandatory biometric enrollment (Iris Scan, Live Photograph & Digital Signature) active at Hyderabad, Cyberabad, Rachakonda, and all district police headquarters.

ELECTION ARMORY DEPOSIT PROTOCOL: Under Telangana State Police orders, all licensed firearms must be deposited with local police station armories or authorized gun houses during statutory election periods.
DUAL VERIFICATION MANDATE: In Telangana, all fresh arms applications undergo simultaneous independent inquiries by the local Police Station (SHO) and the Special Branch (SB).

APPELLATE AUTHORITY: Under Section 18 of The Arms Act, appeals against orders of the Commissioner of Police or District Magistrate lie before the Principal Secretary to Government, Home Department, Telangana Secretariat.

serviceModules.title: Fresh Arms License
serviceModules.description: Apply for a fresh individual self-defense, crop protection, or sports shooting arms license in Telangana. Undergoes dual background verification by the local Police Station (SHO) and Special Branch (SB), accredited firing training, and resident gun safe verification.

serviceModules.title: License Renewal & Re-validation
serviceModules.description: Renew existing arms licenses within the statutory 90-day window under Rule 24. Conducts automated police NOC re-verification, weapon physical inspection, and updated medical certification (Form 1-A) by a Telangana Government Gazetted Medical Officer.

serviceModules.title: Area Validity & Jurisdiction Transfer
serviceModules.description: Apply for area validity extension (District to Telangana State-wide, or recommendation for All-India validity) or transfer of jurisdiction upon relocation between Telangana Commissionerates (Hyderabad, Cyberabad, Rachakonda, Warangal) or revenue districts.

serviceModules.title: Revocation, Surrender & Election Deposit
serviceModules.description: Process statutory suspensions or revocations under Section 17, voluntary license surrender, or record mandatory temporary weapon deposits in police station armories or authorized gun dealers during General and State Assembly Elections.

workflowGovernance.description: A rigorously enforced multi-tiered approval hierarchy structured under the Telangana Police and revenue magistracy administrative framework to ensure independent scrutiny, intelligence clearance, and judicial accountability.

highlights: Dual Police Inquiry System — Simultaneous independent field checks by the local Law & Order Police Station (SHO) and the Special Branch (SB)
Commissioner of Police Jurisdiction — Direct statutory licensing powers exercised by the Commissioner of Police across Hyderabad, Cyberabad, Rachakonda, Warangal, and other Commissionerates
District Magistrate Jurisdiction — Collector & District Magistrate acts as the Licensing Authority in revenue districts, assisted by the Superintendent of Police (SP)
State Appellate Remedy — Appeals against adverse orders of the Licensing Authority lie before the Principal Secretary, Home Department, Telangana Secretariat (Section 18)
Election Custody Monitoring — Integrated digital tracking of weapon deposits in police station armories during statutory election periods
Immutable Audit Ledger — Cryptographic action logging recording officer username, designation, police station, IP address, and timestamp

lifecycle.title: Telangana Arms License Lifecycle Management
lifecycle.description: End-to-end digital lifecycle tracking from citizen submission through local police scrutiny, Special Branch clearance, magisterial order, renewal, and armory deposit.

stages.description: Citizen submits Form II/III with personal details, weapon specifications, justification, Aadhaar verification, and supporting documents.
Licensing branch checks document completeness, identity verification, fee payment receipt, and initiates police verification.
Station House Officer inspects residence, checks gun safe, examines crime records, and records neighbor statements.
Special Branch conducts independent intelligence verification for criminal antecedents and threat assessment.
Applicant attends biometric enrollment (Iris, Live Photograph, and Digital Signature) at designated Police Commissionerate/HQ.
ACP and DCP review both SHO and Special Branch reports, assess threat perception, and record formal recommendations.
Commissioner of Police or District Magistrate evaluates findings and passes a speaking order under Sections 13 and 14.
System generates Form of License (FLAF), allocates a permanent Unique Identification Number (UIN), and issues digital QR license.
Triennial renewal within 90 days, periodic re-verification, and mandatory firearm deposit tracking during election periods.

security.title: State Cybersecurity & Law Enforcement Data Governance
security.description: Enterprise-grade government cybersecurity architecture protecting sensitive police intelligence and citizen records under Indian Cyber Security Guidelines.

features.title: Fine-Grained RBAC
features.description: Strict Role-Based Access Control implementing the principle of least privilege across 26 granular permissions.

features.title: Secure Police Authentication
features.description: Token-based cryptographic authentication with automatic session timeout, device binding, and brute-force protection.

features.title: Cryptographic Audit Ledger
features.description: Non-repudiable audit logs recording officer ID, designation, police station, IP address, and cryptographic timestamp for every action.

features.title: AES-256 Data Encryption
features.description: State security-grade AES-256 encryption for data at rest and TLS 1.3 encryption for all communications in transit.

features.title: Document Vault Security
features.description: Encrypted file storage system with role-restricted access URLs, watermarking, and tamper detection.

features.title: Biometric Vault Protection
features.description: Dedicated secure hardware-isolated vault storing biometric iris scans, photos, and digital signatures.

features.title: Statutory Archival Pattern
features.description: Permanent data preservation with soft-delete strategy ensuring complete historical and legal auditability.

features.title: Real-Time Threat Monitoring
features.description: Continuous security logging and anomaly detection safeguarding state government servers against unauthorized access.
